title: Constant section adjunct under pullback
statement: Let i : Y → X be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], M an abelian group, G an abelian sheaf on the small etale site of X [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and m : constant_X(M) → G [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Put bX = (X,id), bY = (Y,id), and t : bY → i.Etale(bX) the map (i,id) into the fibre product. Let z : i^*constant_X ≅ constant_Y be the canonical constant pullback comparison [lemma-constructible-pullback-constant], η the inverse-image unit [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and σ the constant-sheaf hom adjunction evaluated at the specified identity terminal objects. Then σ_Y(z_M inverse followed by i^*(m)) = σ_X(m) followed by η_G(bX) and (i^*G)(t). This is an equality of homomorphisms M → (i^*G)(bY), for arbitrary i, M, G, and m.

proof.text: Unfold the constant-sheaf pullback comparison as leftAdjointUniq. Its inverse changes the constant-sheaf hom equivalence to the composed constant-sheaf and inverse-image hom equivalences. Expand ofNatIsoRight and the composite hom equivalence; naturality moves m through the inverse-image unit. At the chosen terminal objects this is σ_X(m) followed by the unit and the inverse terminal-preservation isomorphism.

For any map between terminal objects, the constant-sheaf adjunct restricts to the adjunct at the source: expand constantSheafAdj_homEquiv_apply and use naturality of toSheafify followed by m. Precompose the terminal pullback identification with the unique map bY → terminal_Y. Its composite equals t followed by i.Etale(bX → terminal_X), because the pullback of a terminal object is terminal. Unit naturality then moves bX → terminal_X across the unit, yielding the asserted identity at bX and bY.

theorem constantSection_adjunct_pullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Y ⟶ X)
    (M : AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (m : (constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj M ⟶ G) :
    let bX := Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)
    let bY := Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y)
    let t : bY ⟶ (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj bX :=
      MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (pullback.lift i (𝟙 Y)
        ((Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)) (by simp [bX, bY])
    (constantSheafAdj Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (show IsTerminal bY from IsTerminal.ofUniqueHom
        (fun a ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.homMk a.hom (Category.comp_id _))
        (fun a f ↦ by
          apply MorphismProperty.Over.Hom.ext
          exact (Category.comp_id _).symm.trans (MorphismProperty.Over.w f)))).homEquiv M _
      ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).inv.app M ≫
        (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).map m) =
      (constantSheafAdj X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (show IsTerminal bX from IsTerminal.ofUniqueHom
        (fun a ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.homMk a.hom (Category.comp_id _))
        (fun a f ↦ by
          apply MorphismProperty.Over.Hom.ext
          exact (Category.comp_id _).symm.trans (MorphismProperty.Over.w f)))).homEquiv M G m ≫
      ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).unit.app G).hom.app
        (op bX) ≫
      ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).obj G).obj.map t.op
